name: exception_covering_a_built_in_assertion
message: an exception never covers a built-in assertion: what it records is never waived

name: exception_lasting_more_than_a_year
message: an exception in a project's own files lasts at most 365 days from when it starts

name: exception_ending_before_it_starts
message: an exception expires after it starts

name: exception_naming_a_resource_by_its_unit
message: an exception in a project's own files names each resource by its address, scoped by its unit and nothing else
